text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки completes the Arima Kinen,
and the
stands ring with resonant cheers
and applause!

She's overcome with emotion, but she
managed
to show her audience a
beautiful dream. She bows
respectfully
at them and promises that her miracle

will go on.

She's fulfilled her goal of becoming the
greatest
entertainer ever.

The curtains close on Фудзи Кисэки's show,
but the
end is merely another beginning.
The start of her
next show will come
sooner than we know...
